title: Bill To list starts with (this customer), then customers A to Z
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Estimate, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Expand the Customer card.
  3. Click the Bill To field.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Customer card shows a "Bill To" field under Authorizer, reading "This customer".

Step 3:

  • The first option reads "[customer A's name] (this customer)".
  • The customers after it are in A to Z order by name.
  • The Counter Sale customer is not in the list.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “Staff pick or change the Bill To on the work order or part sale Customer card, until it is invoiced.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: pictures "Open" (page 2 "Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", This build), "Change Bill To" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Phone, Change Bill To" (page 3 "When the Bill To is blocked", This build), "Change, open" (page 1 "Set a customer's default Bill To", This build). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
